source_note:
I-66 Express Lanes Outside the Beltway (I-495 to Rt. 29 in Gainesville) has no priced route-resolution tool in this repo -- unlike i66.json's Inside-the-Beltway data, sourced from VDOT's own toll calculator, no such per-trip zone-pricing source has been found for this facility. This file exists only so find_toll_locations can surface real interchange names for discovery.

Nodes below are read directly from the live page's gantry-start-west/gantry-start-east <select> markup (captured 2026-07-26) -- the entrance points for a westbound and an eastbound trip respectively. The corresponding gantry-end-* dropdowns populate via JavaScript only after a start point is chosen (cascading, segment-dependent) and were not captured, so this file covers verified entrances only. It is NOT claimed to be the complete facility list -- the operator's FAQ states 23 entrances and 20 exits total, more than the 22 entrances captured here. No pairs, no pricing, no exit role: unlike the other oracles, every node here has role "entry" only, deliberately, since exit-capability was never observed rather than assumed.
